svg.title: Preview of the Learn overview page
svg.desc: Nine cards. What a map is made of: layers and shapes; what a shape knows; how shapes relate. Six ways to ask a map a question: how many, what overlaps, what is near, how to get there, between measurements, where things concentrate. Each card names the GIS term and the tools or layers of the observatory that the lesson uses.
svg.text: Learn: how a map answers a question
Preview of the overview page (proposal, decision 106). Every card opens a short lesson; every lesson opens the live map on its example.
